# conductorone_session_policy (Data Source)

SessionPolicy DataSource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "conductorone_session_policy" "my_sessionpolicy" {
  page_size  = 0
  page_token = "...my_page_token..."
  query      = "...my_query..."
  refs = [
    {
      id = "...my_id..."
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `page_size` (Number) The pageSize field.
- `page_token` (String) The pageToken field.
- `query` (String) Free-text search over the policy name. Empty matches all policies.
- `refs` (Attributes List) Restrict results to these specific policies. Empty matches all policies. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--refs))

### Read-Only

- `access_token_ttl_seconds` (Number) How long an access token is valid, in seconds.
- `continuous_default_outcome` (Attributes) PolicyOutcome is the effect of a matched rule. Exactly one kind is set. For
 session continuous-evaluation, the meaningful kinds are Allow (continue),
 Deny (terminate), and StepUpRequired.

This message contains a oneof named kind. Only a single field of the following list may be set at a time:
  - allow
  - deny
  - stepUpRequired
  - challengeRequired
  - enrollmentRequired (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--continuous_default_outcome))
- `continuous_rules` (Attributes List) The continuous-evaluation rule cascade, re-checked on every request and on
 inbound shared-signals events. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--continuous_rules))
- `created_at` (String)
- `credential_durations` (Attributes List) Per-credential-type lifetime overrides. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credential_durations))
- `deleted_at` (String)
- `display_name` (String) A human-readable name for the policy.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the policy.
- `idle_timeout_seconds` (Number) How long a session may be idle before it ends, in seconds.
- `is_builtin` (Boolean) True for built-in policies provided by ConductorOne. Built-in policies
 cannot be edited or deleted.
- `max_session_duration_seconds` (Number) The maximum total lifetime of a session, in seconds.
- `next_page_token` (String) The nextPageToken field.
- `persistence` (String) Whether sessions may persist across browser restarts.
- `priority` (Number) When a user matches more than one policy, the policy with the highest
 priority applies.
- `refresh_rotation_window_seconds` (Number) Grace window after rotation during which the previous refresh token is
 still accepted, in seconds (covers in-flight client retries).
- `refresh_token_ttl_seconds` (Number) How long a refresh token is valid, in seconds.
- `rotate_refresh_on_use` (Boolean) Whether to issue a new refresh token each time one is used.
- `ssf_receive` (Attributes) SSFReceiverConfig selects which inbound shared-signals streams this session
 trusts. Each stream's issuer, keys, expected audience, and per-event actions
 are configured on the stream itself; this policy just lists the stream IDs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ssf_receive))
- `ssf_transmit` (Attributes) SSFTransmitterConfig selects which outbound shared-signals streams this
 session emits security events to. Each stream's delivery endpoint,
 authentication, and per-event allowlist are configured on the stream itself;
 this policy just lists the stream IDs and the event types to emit. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ssf_transmit))
- `updated_at` (String)

### Nested Schema for `continuous_default_outcome`

Read-Only:

- `allow` (Attributes) Allow continues the session. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--continuous_default_outcome--allow))
- `challenge_required` (Attributes) ChallengeRequired asks for an additional factor. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--continuous_default_outcome--challenge_required))
- `deny` (Attributes) Deny terminates the session. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--continuous_default_outcome--deny))
- `enrollment_required` (Attributes) EnrollmentRequired tells the user to enroll a credential before continuing. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--continuous_default_outcome--enrollment_required))
- `step_up_required` (Attributes) StepUpRequired demands a stronger re-authentication before the session may
 continue. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--continuous_default_outcome--step_up_required))
